summary: Aegon Ltd. filed a 6-K furnishing its 1H26 results press release dated August 20, 2026, disclosing a EUR 608 million net result, EUR 804 million operating result (up 9%), and EUR 392 million free cash flow. The company announced a 2026 interim dividend of EUR 0.21 per common share, up 11% year over year, and increased its ongoing second-half 2026 share buyback program by EUR 150 million to a total of EUR 350 million, aimed at reducing Cash Capital at Holding to roughly EUR 1.0 billion by year-end 2026 from EUR 1.7 billion. Watch buyback execution pace and the October 8, 2026 EGM on US redomiciliation.
